definitions.full: H2844. chath I. [ חַת ] noun masculine Gen 9:2 terror, fear ; — חָ֑ת Job 41:25 , חִתְּכֶם Gen 9:2 ; — with suffix as object Genitive, 9:2 terror of you (|| מוֺרַאֲכֶם ); in description of crocodile with negative, לִבְלִיחָֿ֑ת הֶעָשׂוּ Job 41:25 one made for fearlessness . II.
